name: Add unit tests for pure math functions
description: Create a comprehensive unit test suite in test/math.test.ts testing the pure functions clamp, lerp, and inRange from src/math.ts.

inputs.task_prompt: Create a new unit test file test/math.test.ts that imports clamp, lerp, and inRange from ../src/math and writes tests using bun:test. Include at least 3 test cases for clamp (clamping below min, within range, and above max), at least 2 test cases for lerp, and at least 2 test cases for inRange. Do not modify src/math.ts.

acceptance_criteria: test/math.test.ts imports clamp, lerp, inRange from src/math
At least 3 test cases for clamp, 2 for lerp, 2 for inRange
